steps.why: Read the order basics: route, windows, deadlines, endpoint details before anything else.

endpoints.instruction: The service desk checks the completed workshop release before giving out the keys. The workshop completion sheet must be signed before the service desk can mark the car ready for collection.
The receiving address has private parking. Confirm the space and who can sign the handover.

steps.why: Read every message on the order to understand what has happened and what the queue flag is about.

messages.body: I have the gig for CD-420299, but I do not have a ferry reference. Is the overnight vehicle crossing booked?
It is not booked. I am checking capacity against the pickup and delivery windows now.
The overnight sailing returned sold out. The later sailing has a quote only. Check driver rest and customer promise before purchase.
The overnight crossing is unavailable. I am checking an alternative and will confirm the revised plan before you start toward the terminal.
Please keep us informed. We need to approve a later delivery date before it is promised to the receiving contact.
The later sailing can work for me if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged. I have not changed my pickup time.
No ferry booking, hotel booking or changed customer promise exists yet. Prepare a reviewable plan with the cost and ETA difference.

steps.why: Read ferry/train/flight options and any reservations with status, quote, cut-off, checked_at.

result.note: A quote (AVAILABLE_QUOTE) is not a booking. A reservation with UNCONFIRMED check-in is not proof of boarding.

steps.why: Read assigned driver, assignment steps, and fee to understand driver rest and logistics.

steps.title: Collect BMW M4 at Tavellor Leipzig, Leipzig

Check prepared digital CMR against the vehicle

steps.why: Confirm whether any earlier booking attempt left a reservation or confirmation, so I do not assume the ferry is unbooked.

attempts.error: Provider request timed out without a confirmation reference. Outcome needs reconciliation; no reservation is recorded.

result.verdict: UNKNOWN: a booking attempt timed out and no reservation or confirmation reference is recorded. Do not retry before reconciling with the provider.

steps.why: Compute whether the driver can reach the terminal before the later sailing's cut-off and whether the delivery window is still reachable after arrival.

result.basis: pickup slot end (win-x78c64fe493374cf4) + road_time_to_terminal_hours vs check_in_cutoff_at. Excludes breaks and traffic (the packet says so).
result.delivery_basis: option arrival_at vs delivery window (win-xd989292fd4c1ccb9); 3h assumed for terminal to address. Not taken from data.
